mapper.sql: FROM parking_permit pp JOIN person p ON p.person_id=pp.holder_person_id JOIN vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id=pp.vehicle_id JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=pp.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id

SELECT pp.parking_permit_id permit_id,pp.permit_no,p.full_name holder_name,v.plate_number,c.community_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼 · ',COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')),' · ',pu.property_no) full_location,pp.eligibility_source,pp.permit_sequence,pp.monthly_rate,pp.charged_months,pp.total_amount,pp.valid_from,pp.valid_to,CASE WHEN pp.permit_status='REVOKED' THEN 'REVOKED' WHEN pp.valid_to<CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN pp.valid_to<=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 'EXPIRING' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END status ORDER BY pp.valid_to ASC,pp.parking_permit_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pu.property_unit_id,NULL residence_id,c.community_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼') building_name,COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')) unit_name,pu.property_no,'OWNERSHIP' source,'YES' eligible,NULL reason_code,NULL remark,NULL expected_end_date,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_permit pp WHERE pp.property_unit_id=pu.property_unit_id AND pp.permit_status='ACTIVE' AND pp.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE) active_permit_count FROM ownership o JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=o.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id WHERE o.person_id=#{personId} AND o.end_date IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT pu.property_unit_id,r.residence_id,c.community_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼') building_name,COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')) unit_name,pu.property_no,'RESIDENCE' source,CASE WHEN e.eligible=1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END eligible,COALESCE(e.reason_code,'OWNER_NOT_GRANTED') reason_code,e.remark,r.expected_end_date,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_permit pp WHERE pp.property_unit_id=pu.property_unit_id AND pp.permit_status='ACTIVE' AND pp.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE) active_permit_count FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id LEFT JOIN residence_parking_eligibility e ON e.residence_id=r.residence_id WHERE r.person_id=#{personId} AND r.end_date IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ownership o WHERE o.person_id=r.person_id AND o.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id AND o.end_date IS NULL) ) x ORDER BY eligible DESC,community_name,building_name,unit_name,property_no
SELECT vehicle_id,plate_number,vehicle_type,brand,color,status FROM vehicle WHERE person_id=#{personId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,vehicle_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vehicle WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND person_id=#{personId} AND status='ACTIVE')

SELECT property_unit_id,residence_id,source,expected_end_date FROM (SELECT o.property_unit_id,NULL residence_id,'OWNERSHIP' source,NULL expected_end_date,1 priority FROM ownership o WHERE o.person_id=#{personId} AND o.property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND o.end_date IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.property_unit_id,r.residence_id,'RESIDENCE' source,r.expected_end_date,2 priority FROM residence r JOIN residence_parking_eligibility e ON e.residence_id=r.residence_id WHERE r.person_id=#{personId} AND r.property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND r.end_date IS NULL AND e.eligible=1) x ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1
SELECT person_id FROM person WHERE person_id=#{personId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT property_unit_id FROM property_unit WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_permit WHERE holder_person_id=#{personId} AND permit_status='ACTIVE' AND valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_permit WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND permit_status='ACTIVE' AND valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parking_permit_application WHERE holder_person_id=#{personId} AND vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND application_status='PENDING')

SELECT a.parking_permit_application_id application_id,a.application_no,p.full_name holder_name,v.plate_number,c.community_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼 · ',COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')),' · ',pu.property_no) full_location,a.eligibility_source,a.requested_valid_from,a.requested_months,a.quoted_permit_sequence,a.quoted_monthly_rate,a.quoted_total_amount,a.application_status status,a.rejection_reason,a.created_at,a.reviewed_at WHERE a.parking_permit_application_id=#{applicationId}

SELECT parking_permit_application_id application_id,holder_person_id person_id,vehicle_id,property_unit_id,residence_id,eligibility_source source,requested_months months,requested_valid_from,application_status status FROM parking_permit_application WHERE parking_permit_application_id=#{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_permit_application SET application_status='APPROVED',reviewed_by_account_id=#{accountId},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),quoted_permit_sequence=#{sequence},quoted_monthly_rate=#{rate},quoted_total_amount=#{total},rejection_reason=NULL WHERE parking_permit_application_id=#{applicationId} AND application_status='PENDING'

UPDATE parking_permit_application SET application_status='REJECTED',reviewed_by_account_id=#{accountId},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),rejection_reason=#{reason} WHERE parking_permit_application_id=#{applicationId} AND application_status='PENDING'

SELECT a.parking_permit_application_id application_id,a.application_no,p.full_name holder_name,v.plate_number,c.community_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼 · ',COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')),' · ',pu.property_no) full_location,a.eligibility_source,a.requested_valid_from,a.requested_months,a.quoted_permit_sequence,a.quoted_monthly_rate,a.quoted_total_amount,a.application_status status,a.rejection_reason,a.created_at,a.reviewed_at WHERE a.holder_person_id=#{personId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
